original_budget.platform: Separate isolated c7i.4xlarge, eight physical cores, 24 GiB cgroup, zero swap, 320 GiB gp3 root; same model, cfg, seed, fp and profile as product_capacity. --max-memory 24g --time-limit 7200s, no state limit.
original_budget.sample_method: Every 15 s, sampled cgroup current/peak, memory.stat anon and file, and total root filesystem use. Independent read-only observer every 20 s read the discovery ID at the last complete disk index entry of each active frontier. This is a lower bound on discoveries, not terminal checker statistics.
original_budget.infrastructure_note: An earlier pair was interrupted during SSH reachability loss. Neither produced a terminal checker report and neither contributed a result.

platform: Separate isolated c7i.4xlarge in us-east-1 per cohort, gp3 storage, 24 GiB cgroup, 8 physical cores, one process at a time. GNU time measures wall seconds and process peak RSS.
command: dive check MODULE --config CFG --workers 8 --fp 0 --seed 0 --compat=tlc --max-states PREFIX --max-memory 8g --time-limit 300s --output json
build_recipe: Linux x86_64 release, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=false CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16; fingerprint store. Base built from main 167813374.

block_compression.codec: lz4_flex 0.14.2 safe block encoder and decoder, original bytes when compression would expand the chunk. Each compressed record carries its decoded size and is checked before import.

sample.selection: 64 evenly spaced full records per active frontier during the longer uncompressed BPConProof run. Sizes exclude the index and outer queue record. Reference liblz4 verified every decompressed payload byte for byte.

block_compression.platform: Two sequential fresh processes on one isolated c7i.4xlarge, us-east-1a, eight physical cores pinned, 320 GiB gp3 root, hard 24 GiB cgroup with zero swap. Ubuntu Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws. Same release settings, compiled parent and compression change. GNU time measures wall seconds and process peak RSS.

resident_rows.platform: Isolated AWS r7i.8xlarge, native x86_64, eight physical cores, 24 GiB cgroup, swap disabled. Each invocation is a fresh release process. Same inputs and hardware for both binaries.
resident_rows.source: row-base on main after symmetry-buffer reuse. row-packed is the engineering build with native resident row compression, before final error handling and integration with external membership. Its timing applies to the hashed binary.
resident_rows.command: taskset -c 0-7 BINARY check MODULE --config CFG --library-path modules --workers 8 --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --max-states N --max-memory 18g --time-limit 600s --output json
resident_rows.capture: First 999,424 complete rows from the first million ordinary Core admissions on each input. Byte counts describe an offline row-layout comparison excluding allocator overhead. End-to-end peak RSS is independently measured below.

pressure.method: Same exclusive r7i.8xlarge and binaries/inputs as resident_rows. 16 physical cores 0-15, 10 GiB cgroup with no swap. Each process had a 6 GiB sampled budget; observed peaks can exceed it before a safe boundary. Baseline then packed within each model, single run per arm.
pressure.command: taskset -c 0-15 BINARY check MODULE --config CFG --library-path modules --workers 16 --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --max-states N --max-memory 6g --time-limit 1500s --output json

resident_discovery_ids.platform: Isolated AWS c7i.4xlarge, eight physical cores and 24 GiB cgroup without swap. Consecutive fresh processes. GNU time reports wall seconds and peak RSS.
resident_discovery_ids.command: taskset -c 0-7 BINARY check MODULE --config CFG --library-path modules --workers 8 --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --max-states N --time-limit 900s --max-memory 18g --output json
resident_discovery_ids.inputs: Identical to resident_rows.models and their module and configuration hashes in this record. Both binaries already pack resident state rows.
